name: 沐阳手绘视频
title_zh: 白板动画全流程：脚本、手绘、配音、字幕一条龙
tagline_zh: 给个主题，自动产出带手绘风格动画的讲解视频，中文配音和字幕同步生成，适合做科普、课程、营销短片。
tagline_en: Give a topic, get a complete hand-drawn whiteboard video with Chinese voiceover and subtitles. Ideal for lessons.
desc_en: Use when a user asks for 沐阳手绘视频, create-handdrawn-explainer, a complete hand-drawn explainer, whiteboard animation, illustrated lesson, narrated short video, Remotion MP4, automatic Chinese voiceover, subtitles, or a topic-to-video workflow.
why_zh: 不是简单套模板，而是从脚本到成片全自动，手绘动画配合语音节奏，视觉和听觉同步，效果自然不生硬。
why_en: Not just a template: it generates the script, animates visuals in sync with narration, and adds subtitles automatically—coherent.
limit_zh: 需要网络和Remotion环境；仅支持中文配音；手绘风格固定，不可自定义笔触或画风；视频长度有限制，超长内容需分段处理。
limit_en: Requires network and Remotion. Chinese voiceover only. Fixed hand-drawn style. Video length limited; split long content.
title_en: Full hand-drawn explainer: script, animation, voiceover.
